ov: The hybrid of a male lion and a female tiger, and the largest living cat. It is tawny like a lion with faint tiger stripes, likes swimming like a tiger and is sociable like a lion. Ligers exist only in captivity; male ligers are sterile, but females can breed.

why.dg: Bigger than either parent, and its parents, lions and tigers, both kill people.

wt: Males up to about 500 kg; females about 320 kg
rg: Only in captivity. Lion and tiger ranges overlap only in India's Gir National Park, and no ligers have been found there.

cf.tip: A liger has a lion father and a tiger mother and grows bigger than both; a tigon has a tiger father and a lion mother and is no bigger than its parents.

fx: Hercules, a liger recognised by Guinness as the largest living cat, weighed 418 kg.
Ligers usually live 13–18 years; a ligress named Shasta reached 24.
